cpu.description: Aggregate sustained CPU percentage across descendants. 100 is one core; 0 disables the cap. Sampled every 2s, terminating after 18 consecutive high samples.

env.description: Child environment variables. Keys merge; an empty value clears an inherited value.

mem.description: Aggregate RSS cap, e.g. 2GiB or 512MB. Empty disables the cap. Includes descendants and is sampled immediately, then every 2s.

nice.description: Child niceness adjustment, from -20 to 19. Increasing priority requires OS permission.

timeout.description: Positive Go duration for each invocation, e.g. 5m. Empty disables the inherited per-invocation deadline. Separate from the whole-run deadline.

testTimeout.description: Deadline for each test-package subprocess (one go test / ginkgo / vitest invocation), as a Go duration. A suite that exceeds it is killed and reported as a timeout. Overridden by --test-timeout.

timeout.description: Wall-clock deadline for the whole test+lint run, as a Go duration. On timeout diagnostics are captured and every subprocess is killed. Overridden by --timeout.

baseUrl.description: Absolute origin this gavel dashboard is reachable at (e.g. https://gavel.example.com). Todo bodies store attachments as server-relative links, so pushing a todo to an external tracker rewrites them against this origin. A loopback origin only renders for viewers on the same machine.

checkConcurrency.description: How many definition-of-done checks run at once (`gavel todos check`, and the verification phase after a bulk triage). Each check runs the TODO's fixture, so an unbounded fan-out over a large selection thrashes the machine. Defaults to 4.

lifecycle.description: Overrides the built-in lifecycle: ordered steps with a Captain prompt reference, a CEL `when` over subject/event/runs/last, and ordered `outcomes` mapping the finished run onto a status. Either `file` (a lifecycle YAML relative to the project) or an inline `name`/`subject`/`steps`. A step named like an inherited step replaces it wholesale; a new name is appended. TODO verification must remain enabled.

disabled.description: Inherited step names to disable. An explicit empty list re-enables inherited steps. TODO verification cannot be disabled.

file.description: Path to a lifecycle YAML document, relative to the project root. Mutually exclusive with the inline form.

name.description: Name of the lifecycle; inherits the built-in name.

order.description: Step names in priority order. Unlisted steps retain their inherited relative order.

steps.description: Steps to replace or add: {name, prompt, events, when, inputs, spec, outcomes, auxiliary}. Outcomes are `{status, when}` pairs evaluated in order; the first true wins and none true is an error.

auxiliary.description: Offer for explicit selection without making it the default next step.

events.description: Allowed events in the prompt's result envelope.

inputs.description: Prompt inputs, mapped to CEL expressions.

status.description: Outcome name; TODO workflows require a supported TODO status.

when.description: CEL predicate over the completed run.

prompt.description: Built-in prompt ID or file:<project prompt path>.

spec.description: Captain execution settings for this step.

tools.description: Tool sets available to this step.

when.description: CEL applicability over subject, event, runs and last.

subject.description: Extra subject declarations a custom step's predicates may read, field → CEL type (string, bool, int, double, dyn, list<string>, list<dyn>, map<string,dyn>).

merge.description: AI spec for the merge prompt: the one-shot pass behind `gavel todos merge` that folds several TODOs into one title, body, verification fixture and plan. It records no run, so it is not a lifecycle step.

budget.description: Resource ceilings for the run. Zero/unset means unbounded.

cost.description: Maximum spend in USD; 0 = no ceiling.

maxTokens.description: Cap on output tokens per model call; 0 = backend default.

maxTurns.description: Cap on agent turns; 0 = backend default.

fallbacks.description: Alternative model slugs tried in order when the primary is unavailable or its provider cannot be constructed.

It overrides ai: and is overridden by the request. There is no prompt to override — the checklist is generated from the todo's acceptance criteria.

model.description: Catalog model slug the grader runs as. It must run on an agentic mechanism (mode agent, cli or cmux — e.g. `agent:sonnet`): the grader is told to inspect the change with its own tools, and an API model returns confident verdicts without reading the diff.
